lines: HARISH NARSHI DHARAMSHI, role unknown, is due proceeds from selling 8,983,700 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹243.46 crore are scheduled on or about Wednesday, October 21, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares, estimated at ₹2,421.85 crore, mean more value later; family link to KUSUM HARISH DHARAMSHI.
Role is unknown and the listing date is unconfirmed, so verify both before the call.
